scripts.start: npm run build:modules && ng serve --configuration development
scripts.build: npm run build:modules && ng build frontend --configuration production
scripts.build:modules: npm run generate:components && ng build ui-framework && ng build flow-platform && ng build patient-workflow && ng build appointments && ng build laboratory-portal && ng build flow-editor
scripts.build:flow-platform: npm run build:ui-framework && ng build flow-platform
scripts.build:patient-workflow: npm run generate:components && npm run build:flow-platform && ng build patient-workflow
scripts.build:appointments: npm run build:patient-workflow && ng build appointments
scripts.build:laboratory-portal: npm run build:flow-platform && ng build laboratory-portal
scripts.build:flow-editor: npm run build:flow-platform && ng build flow-editor
scripts.watch: npm run build:modules && ng build frontend --watch --configuration development
scripts.test: npm run build:modules && ng test frontend --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test ui-framework --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test flow-platform --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test patient-workflow --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test appointments --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test laboratory-portal --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && ng test flow-editor --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
